_howto: All site content lives in this file. Replace images with your own uploads (the /_blob/... url an upload returns), and edit text freely. Projects appear in the order listed; the editorial grid repeats a 6-slot pattern, so any number of projects works. hero[].project points at a project slug; hero[].slot (a–e) is its place in the landing collage.

statement.text: Light first, then rhythm. I shoot and edit
